chapter: Carey band, jazz and drum demonstrations
title: Playing the drumsticks on the bass violin strings
summary: During quiet passages he leaves his drum and beats the strings of the bass while the player fingers; they demonstrate it and use such tricks against rival bands in the street.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique
